video_title: Iman Shumpert’s HEAD says the Spurs, but his HEART says… 🧡💙 | The Pat McAfee Show

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks have the advantage in Game 1 against the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: I think that the Knicks have the advantage. They have a lot of answers for what San Antonio has.
quotes.quote: For Game 1, I think that the Knicks have the advantage. They have been sitting at home, they are probably bouncing off the walls, they have home-cooked meals. They are feeling real good rolling into this. I think that they have a lot of answers for what San Antonio has. I am expecting the Knicks to throw a good punch and take Game 1.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Why the Knicks' style of play is difficult for Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: If you can catch Victor Wembanyama on a Saturday, he is different than if you can catch him Saturday, Monday, Wednesday.
quotes.quote: It is different when you have to play game in, game out against the same team. If you can catch Victor Wembanyama on a Saturday, he is different than if you can catch him Saturday, Monday, and Wednesday. You start preparing for him, you start understanding the things he likes to do, you know their play calls, your mind is recalibrated to say this is how high I need to shoot my floater.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks' defense is underrated and highly effective
quotes.excerpt: We don't talk about the Knicks' defense as much, but the Knicks' defense is damn good.
quotes.quote: We don't talk about the Knicks' defense as much, but the Knicks' defense is damn good. They have guards that can defend penetration, they take on the challenge. The Eastern Conference is different than the Western Conference. The way the game is played on the East Coast is a little different too, and I think they are going to have to get adjusted to that.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs' cross-court passing style and Knicks' defensive response
quotes.excerpt: The Spurs like to whip a cross-court pass a lot of times, especially Victor Wembanyama spinning into that move.
quotes.quote: The Spurs like to whip a cross-court pass a lot of times, especially Victor Wembanyama spinning into that move, trying to get downhill, in and out cross, get to that spin and then whip a pass across the court. Mikal Bridges, OG Anunoby, Josh Hart, these are guys that shoot the gap. These are guys that defend at a high level because they know sometimes they cannot get it going offensively. They are going to be outright thirsty out there to get those deflections.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Devin Vassell and Harrison Barnes must step up for Spurs
quotes.excerpt: I am expecting Devin Vassell to play well just because he is one of the older guys.
quotes.quote: I am expecting Devin Vassell to play well just because he is one of the older guys, one of the guys that has been along with that team, with that organization for the most years. I cannot imagine Devin Vassell coming out there and not being ready to play, not being ready to lead. Harrison Barnes is going to have to step up and be a big-time performer in this just because he has that experience.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks built their roster to support Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: The reason that team was built the way it was built is to support and hide Jalen Brunson.
quotes.quote: The Knicks have done a great job in building that team. The reason that team was built the way it was built is to support and hide Jalen Brunson at times so that he can lean and hang his hat on the offensive end and be that Mr. Fourth Quarter guy for them.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: The difficulty of winning with a smaller guard
quotes.excerpt: It is hard to win with a smaller guard because for the end of the game.
quotes.quote: It is hard to win with a smaller guard because for the end of the game, when you have to go back and forth and do a slugfest, do you really want a guy that is 6'2" being able to be shot over if somebody goes to a fadeaway package?
